from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartEntry(BaseModel):
    """One data point extracted from a single release report."""
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released, to resolve precedence (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    release_identifier: str | None = Field(description="The report's release ID number (e.g., CB22-156), if available in the text")
    data_month: str = Field(description="The specific month-year the data value represents (YYYY-MM)")
    saar_value: float = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) value for total U.S. housing starts (in thousands or full count, as stated in the document)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_entries: list[HousingStartEntry]
